card.name: Few colors without any bicolored cycle

task.name: Few colors without any bicolored cycle
task.description: construct() -> fifty Python integer color labels in 0..49 for the pinned degree-four graph. Adjacent vertices must differ and the subgraph induced by any two colors must be a forest. Minimize number of distinct colors; union-find detects bicolored cycles exactly. A fixed 50-vertex degree-four circulant graph with steps 1 and 7 is colored. A lower score is a better finite coloring, not a new general maximum-degree bound.
